name: Saint William of Vercelli
history: A northern Italian who, after a pilgrimage to Compostela as a youth, became a hermit in the mountains of southern Italy. Disciples gathered round him on Monte Vergine, near Avellino, and he founded the monastery there, which became the head of a Benedictine congregation and one of the great Marian shrines of Italy.
life: William was born at Vercelli in Piedmont and orphaned young. Still in his teens, he set out as a pilgrim to the shrine of Saint James at Compostela, and on his return resolved to go on to Jerusalem. On the way south he was stopped, tradition holds, by robbers or by a sense that God wanted him in Italy, and he settled as a hermit on Monte Vergine. Others came to share his life, and around 1119 a church and monastery rose there. He gave his followers a strict rule of poverty and prayer, but some later wanted an easier life, and William left them in peace to found other houses in the south, among them the abbey of Goleto, where he died in 1142. King Roger II of Sicily valued his counsel. The shrine of Our Lady of Montevergine still draws great crowds of pilgrims.
prayerTo: Saint William, pilgrim and hermit, you set out on the road and found God waiting on a mountain. Pray for all pilgrims and for those who do not know where God is leading them. Help me to travel lightly, to pray often, and to rest at last in the Lord. Amen.
penance: Make a short pilgrimage on foot today, to a church or shrine near you, and pray there for someone in need.
meditation: He set out for Jerusalem and God stopped him halfway. Can you accept a plan of yours being changed for a better one?
prayer: O God, Who made Your Saints an example and a help for our weakness; grant us, as we walk the path of salvation, so to venerate the virtues of the blessed Abbot William that we may obtain his intercession and follow in his footsteps. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
